rules: This manifest permits neither direct database writes nor automatic Cloudinary uploads.

assets.rightsBasis: Official University of Madras lock-up served from the University's own e-governance domain (egovernance.unom.ac.in) on its 2026-27 admissions portal. No open licence; used only to identify the institution. Checked 2026-10-23: HTTP 200, image/png, 27,676 bytes, 420x100 px, transparent background. Viewed on white and legible: the University crest (shield with elephant, lotus and motto ribbon) beside 'சென்னைப் பல்கலைக்கழகம்', 'UNIVERSITY OF MADRAS' in dark blue and 'Estd. 1857, State University'. Rejected: https://egovernance.unom.ac.in/logo.PNG (803x183) because it carries a NAAC A++ seal that could not be verified on NAAC's own list; https://egovernance.unom.ac.in/univ.png is a 16x16 favicon. Wide format (100 px tall); a square crest crop would suit square tiles better.

Wikimedia Commons, 'Madras University Senate House.jpg' by Jonas Buchholz (Jbuchholz), 7 September 2011, licensed CC BY-SA 3.0; attribution and share-alike required. Checked 2026-10-23: HTTP 200, image/jpeg, 794,091 bytes, 1920x1280 px rendition of a 3810x2540 original. Visually confirmed as a single real photograph, not a composite or AI image: the red-brick Indo-Saracenic Senate House at Chepauk with its domed towers behind lawns and trees, a statue on the right; no text overlay; no identifiable people. Rejected: https://egovernance.unom.ac.in/Building.png (an AI-generated composite of invented towers with a signboard), 'Senate House University of Madras Chennai India.jpg' (taken through a vehicle windscreen with glare and identifiable passers-by).
assets.altText: The red-brick Senate House of the University of Madras at Chepauk, Chennai, with domed towers behind lawns and trees
